notes: Specs pulled from AJA's own spec sheet PDF (aja.com/products/12gda/spec-sheet.pdf), cross-checked against the product page (aja.com/products/12gda). Miniature desktop unit (5.8 x 3.1 x 1 in / 147 x 79 x 25 mm, 0.7 lb) — not rack-mountable as sold, so rackUnits omitted (an optional third-party/AJA rack shelf can hold multiple mini-converters but that's not native rack-mount). It is a 1x6 12G-SDI reclocking distribution amplifier: 1 SDI input fanned out to 6 separately buffered/reclocked SDI outputs identical to the recovered input. Connector type on all video ports is BNC carrying SDI (SMPTE-259/292/424/2081/2082); grade set to sdi-12g since the device supports up to 12G-SDI (auto-reclocks 270Mbps-11.88Gbps rates, passes other rates 100Mbps-12Gbps through unreclocked) — actual per-cable/per-signal rate will vary with source. Power port labeled simply "POWER" on the unit, rated +5-20VDC/3W; ships with an included universal 100-240VAC external AC adapter. The physical DC input connector is AJA's proprietary locking barrel-style jack (visible in the product photo) — "dc-barrel" is the closest match in the allowed connector list, not an exact vendor-spec match. No Ethernet, USB, or other control/data ports are present on this model (note: a separate related product, the OG-12GDA-2x4 openGear card, exists with different I/O and is NOT this device).
